integrity: The primary arXiv full text was inspected at Definition 2.1, Assumption 4.1, Lemmas 4.1--4.2, Algorithm 1, and Theorem 4.1. The counterexample and repaired inequality were independently reconstructed algebraically and replayed by a standalone script.
scientific_limitations: The finding isolates Lemma 4.2 and supplies a segmentwise repair. It does not establish failure of the paper's convergence theorems, and the repaired nonconvex statement requires a Hessian operator-norm bound on the actual trial segment.
title: A scalar-quadratic counterexample and sharp repair for the Regime-0 KGD lower bound
